svg.title: leereilly/star-chart
svg.desc: Star history for leereilly/star-chart over all time. 25 current stars. 25 recorded additions in range. 2026-09-08 to 2026-09-20. Scale: absolute. Display intervals subdivide nominal API weeks; the final week may still be partial. Column height approximates cumulative recorded stars in whole tiles; shading marks distance below each column tip, not value ranges. Some weeks had no recorded data and were treated as zero.
